details: Batch for Nov 28 sent, waiting for approval
summary: Of the 35 reels posted in the last 7 days (Nov 21 to 27), only 12 can be counted; the other 23 show 0 to 3 views. The 12 drew 3,168 views in total, typically about 128 each. The typical 3-second hold is 17.5%, down from 18.6% the week before (8,792 views on 28 reels). In the current block, O1 (a number line over the book) is ahead of O6 (the reel opens on the spine) by 5.7 points, 21.0% against 15.3%, but that rests on 226 views for O1 and 483 for O6, both under the 500 views needed, so it means little yet. Best recent reel by hold: The Sealed Nectar on Nov 24, 24.6% on 144 views. Worst: Commentary on the Three Fundamental Principles on Nov 27, 8.5% on 112 views. A pattern in the reels with no views: when a book is posted again with the same opening it had before, 20 of 23 such reels got no views, while 32 of 42 first-time pairings did get views. Today's batch is a fourth day of the same test, O1 against O6, on five books that did not run yesterday.
change: The O1 against O6 test could not be decided this morning: after three days O1 has 226 views and O6 has 483, and each needs 500. Nothing in the formula changes and O1, a number line over the book, stays in front. The schedule moves back a day: a fourth day of the same test runs today and the decision moves to Sun Nov 29. The next test is not set until this one is decided.
